rows.commentary: 0.1: Xavier Bartlett drops it on a length at 127.8kph to leave Tom Banton grasping at thin air.
0.2: Tom Banton flashes on the up against a shortish delivery, slicing a thick edge down to deep third for his first run.
0.3: Ben Duckett tries to clip a delivery angling down leg, missing the ball within the revised guidelines.
0.4: Ben Duckett pushes forward defensively as a fuller delivery sharply leaves him beaten on the outside edge.
0.5: Xavier Bartlett strays down leg, allowing Ben Duckett to effortlessly glance it fine for a boundary.
0.6: Ben Duckett wears an incoming delivery on the pads, surviving a loud appeal as it heads down leg and high.
1.1: Spencer Johnson unleashes a vicious 133.8kph delivery that pitches full on off-stump, nipping away sharply to leave Tom Banton completely flummoxed on the defensive push.
1.2: Tom Banton flicks this full 136kph pad-high delivery crisply toward deep backward square, where Beardman launches into a full-stretch dive to brilliantly palm it back from the rope.
1.3: Tom Banton throws the kitchen sink at a short delivery angling wide outside off, connecting with nothing but air.
1.4: Tom Banton goes hard across the line, sending a top edge flying over the slip cordon to the boundary.
1.5: Tom Banton gets forward to a full incoming delivery, timing a gorgeous drive to the right of wide mid-on for four.
1.6: Tom Banton lifts his bat high and watches a very full delivery pass harmlessly across wide of off.
2.1: Xavier Bartlett dangles the width, Ben Duckett snaps the cut away, and Jack Edwards throws his frame across to intercept at backward point.
2.2: Xavier Bartlett searches for the pads with a hint of inward curve, allowing Ben Duckett to tuck it around smoothly toward deep fine leg.
2.3: Xavier Bartlett probes with a seductive full length shaping away from Tom Banton, who watches it sail past his bat.
2.4: Xavier Bartlett draws his length back while maintaining that away movement, leaving Tom Banton entirely unbothered.
2.5: Xavier Bartlett tightens his line closer to the paint, yet Tom Banton steadfastly offers no stroke to the outswinger.
2.6: Xavier Bartlett forces the ball back sharply off a length into Tom Banton, rapping the pad high as the umpire instantly waves away the loud appeal.
3.1: No run for Ben Duckett off Spencer Johnson.
12.3: Xavier Bartlett slides one into the pads, allowing Jordan Cox to work it away cleanly into the leg side for a single.
12.4: Xavier Bartlett attacks the stumps with a full delivery, and Joe Root finds the fielder at mid-on with his push.
12.5: Xavier Bartlett drops it full on the legs, turning a wristy clip into deep square leg while nearly colliding mid-pitch with the bowler.
12.6: Xavier Bartlett tests the batter with a disciplined good length delivery that Jordan Cox easily negotiates.
13.1: Mahli Beardman sends down a wide full delivery outside off stump, leaving Joe Root entirely unbothered.
13.2: Mahli Beardman probes the channel outside off, met securely on the defensive stroke by Joe Root.
13.3: Mahli Beardman digs it in short, enabling Joe Root to pull behind square and scamper back for a comfortable two runs.
13.4: Mahli Beardman finds a nervous inside edge that races past the woodwork and away for a fortunate boundary.
13.5: Mahli Beardman pitches on a sound length, solidly blocked back down the pitch by Joe Root.
13.6: Mahli Beardman extracts the edge with late movement away, and Josh Inglis accepts a straightforward catch behind the stumps.
14.1: Spencer Johnson targets the stumps on a good length, securely defended from the crease by Jordan Cox.
14.2: Spencer Johnson forces an inside edge onto the pad with another accurate delivery on a length.
14.3: Spencer Johnson delivers a 136kph good length ball wide of off, and Jordan Cox chops a square drive over point for a single.
14.4: Spencer Johnson hits a 135kph good length, angled-in delivery that nips away past the edge, leaving Sam Curran stuck on the crease playing inside the line to poke and miss.
14.5: Spencer Johnson nearly pulls off a one-handed stunner off his own bowling, sticking his left hand out to half-stop Sam Curran's airborne straight drive off a full fourth-stump ball.
14.6: Spencer Johnson drops it on a good length, and Sam Curran safely gets behind the ball to defend.
25.1: Adam Zampa opens his account with a sharp turner that viciously beats Gus Atkinson's outside edge.
25.2: Adam Zampa drags his length back slightly, allowing Gus Atkinson to stay back and comfortably block.
25.3: Adam Zampa tosses it up at nearly eighty-six clicks as Gus Atkinson strides forward to push it toward cover.
25.4: Adam Zampa slows the pace down further outside off, inducing a mistimed drive from Gus Atkinson toward backward point.
25.5: Adam Zampa fires this one in at over eighty-eight kph, met securely by a forward defensive prod from Gus Atkinson.
25.6: Adam Zampa shortens his delivery once more, permitting Gus Atkinson an easy defensive push off the back foot.
26.1: Jack Edwards steams in at one hundred twenty-seven kph, serving up a full length that Will Jacks forces firmly toward the cover region.
26.2: Jack Edwards tempts Will Jacks with a probing channel offering outside off, but the batsman watches it sail past.
26.3: Jack Edwards targets a testing length at one hundred twenty-five kph, neatly stroked along the carpet to mid-on by Will Jacks.
26.4: Jack Edwards gets the ball to shape away marginally outside the tramlines, prompting an easy leave from Will Jacks.
26.5: Jack Edwards delivers at one hundred twenty-five kph, answered by a textbook forward defense from Will Jacks right off the middle.
26.6: Jack Edwards angles one inward on a good length, but Will Jacks judges his off stump to perfection and leaves it alone.
27.1: Adam Zampa tosses it up outside off, beating Gus Atkinson's hard-handed forward defense with dip and sharp away-turn as Inglis whips off the bails to appeal.
27.2: Adam Zampa fires a full delivery into off stump, safely blocked back into the pitch by a long stride from Gus Atkinson.
27.3: Adam Zampa darts an 87.3kph delivery onto the pads, drawing a leading edge from Gus Atkinson that rolls harmlessly to the bowler's right.
27.4: Adam Zampa serves a full, leg-lined delivery that Gus Atkinson nudges through mid-wicket to claim a single.
27.5: Adam Zampa errs too full once again, allowing Will Jacks to comfortably ease it down the ground.
27.6: Adam Zampa strays down the leg side as Gus Atkinson fails to connect with his clip, prompting the wide signal.
31.5: Mahli Beardman tests Jofra Archer with a length ball, safely blocked into the point region with soft hands.
31.6: Jofra Archer plays a defensive prod that takes a thick outside edge, trickling down to deep backward point for a single.
32.1: Jofra Archer scrambles home safely after a direct hit follows a quick single off Spencer Johnson's short delivery.
32.2: Gus Atkinson cuffs a pull shot wide of fine leg for two runs as chaotic running nearly invites a direct hit on Jofra Archer.
32.3: Spencer Johnson digs it in short, and Gus Atkinson pounces, pivoting to hammer the pull through mid-wicket for four.
32.4: Spencer Johnson digs another short one far too high, sailing over the swinging Gus Atkinson's head without contact for a wide.
32.4: Gus Atkinson reads the length early, backing away to clear the infield and slash Spencer Johnson through the off side for four.
32.5: Spencer Johnson tosses it full, allowing Gus Atkinson to drill a straight drive directly into the hands of mid-off.
32.6: Spencer Johnson bangs it in short again, and Gus Atkinson stands tall to pull it all the way over deep square leg for six.
33.1: Mahli Beardman overpitches, and Jofra Archer presents the full face to punch a clean drive firmly down the ground for four.
33.2: Mahli Beardman immediately responds with a sharp bouncer that zips past Jofra Archer's wild, flashing blade.
33.3: Mahli Beardman hits a lively shortish length, skidding off the pitch to easily beat Jofra Archer's defensive prod.
33.4: Mahli Beardman claims his sixth wicket as Jofra Archer slashes a wide delivery to backward point, where Jack Edwards dives left to snap up the catch and seal England's dismissal for 131.
9.2: Jofra Archer drops it full and wide of off stump, allowing Josh Inglis to watch it sail harmlessly into the keeper's gloves.
9.3: Jofra Archer attacks the channel on a short of a length, forcing Josh Inglis onto the back foot for a solid defensive push.
9.4: Jofra Archer tests Josh Inglis with another sharp back-of-a-length delivery, safely dead-batting off the crease.
9.5: Jofra Archer hits the same probing length, and Josh Inglis answers with another watchful defensive stroke from the crease.
9.6: Jofra Archer serves up a full invitation that Josh Inglis gratefully accepts, caressing a pristine cover drive past the England captain and all the way to the boundary rope.
10.1: Gus Atkinson delivers a full ball angled into the stumps, gently tapped away toward mid-on by Cooper Connolly.
10.2: Gus Atkinson tests Cooper Connolly just outside off stump, met with a firm back-foot defense.
10.3: Gus Atkinson digs it in slightly shorter, and Cooper Connolly handles the bounce smoothly off the back foot.
10.4: Gus Atkinson steims in from round the wicket, pinning Cooper Connolly to the crease for yet another defensive block.
10.5: Gus Atkinson maintains his relentless length, smartly covered and kept out by Cooper Connolly.
10.6: Gus Atkinson bangs it in short, and a scrambling Cooper Connolly gets a top edge that sails all the way over fine leg for a maximum.
11.1: Jofra Archer squares up Josh Inglis with a vicious delivery outside off that flashes past the outside edge, leaving the bowler appealing in vain.
11.2: Archer digs it in short on the leg stump, Inglis pulls it away to deep backward square leg where a sliding stop restricts them to a single.
11.3: Archer offers width outside off at searing pace, and Connolly violently slashes it past backward point for a crisp boundary.
11.4: Archer delivers another harmless short ball outside off, but Connolly plays a tame steer straight into the hands of Will Jacks at backward point to depart for 27.
11.5: Archer attacks the leg stump on a good length, and Renshaw gets forward to defend solidly.
11.6: Archer pushes this one well wide of the off stump, inviting Renshaw to watch it sail past safely.
20.5: Gus Atkinson delivers round the wicket at 138kph, and Matt Renshaw gently tucks the full ball toward mid-wicket.
20.6: Gus Atkinson bangs it in short at 140kph, and Matt Renshaw rides the bounce to defend.
21.1: Jamie Overton digs it in as Josh Inglis dances out and throws his hands at thin air.
21.2: Jamie Overton goes very full to seam past the inside edge, leaving the bowler with his hands on his head.
21.3: Jamie Overton tests the back of a length outside off, and Josh Inglis hops across to leave it.
21.4: Jamie Overton fires down a 144kph good-length delivery that Josh Inglis stands tall to defend into the covers.
21.5: Jamie Overton pitches it up into the pads, and Josh Inglis plinks it uppishly toward mid-on before it drops short.
21.6: Jamie Overton gets worked off the pads to square leg as Josh Inglis takes a single to bring the requirement into single figures.
22.1: Sam Curran comes over the wicket and pitches it up, allowing Josh Inglis to carve it up and over cover for two.
22.2: Sam Curran sends down an 80mph fullish delivery that Josh Inglis gets forward to block square.
22.3: Sam Curran gets a hint of inswing on a pitched-up ball that induces a low leading edge into the covers from Josh Inglis.
22.4: Sam Curran rolls out a slower short ball that Josh Inglis pulls in the air down to fine leg for a single.
22.5: Sam Curran fires one in at 129.2kph directly on the stumps, and Matt Renshaw whips it firmly but straight to the fielder stationed at mid-wicket.
22.6: Sam Curran clocks 130.2kph, allowing Matt Renshaw to wait on the length delivery and deftly open the bat face to guide it toward third man for a single.
23.1: Jamie Overton serves up a fullish delivery that Matt Renshaw launches loftily over mid-on down the ground for a boundary, leaving Australia needing just one more run.
23.2: Jamie Overton tests him with a delivery that Matt Renshaw hangs back to defend neatly into the cover point area.

23.3: Jamie Overton delivers as Matt Renshaw swipes it towards deep mid-wicket for a comfortable single, sealing a dominant seven-wicket victory for Australia over England with over 24 overs to spare to take a 1-0 series lead.

preview.text: Australia and England meet in a one-day match at Perth Stadium, with Australia winning the toss and choosing to bowl first. The teams have played 85 recorded one-day meetings between them, where Australia won 52 and England won 32. The forecast for the next 8 hours shows up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 25 degrees.

summary.text: ENG scored 131-10 in their innings, led by Gus Atkinson with 29 off 32 balls, while Mahli Beardman took 6 for 24. AUS responded with 132-3 to win by 7 wkts, featuring Mitchell Marsh (c) as top scorer with 50 off 30 balls against Jamie Overton who claimed 1 for 35.
